title: Quote: (on what he wants) To make Apple a great $10 billion company...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: The Birth of the Mac: Rolling Stone's 1984 Feature on Steve Jobs and his Whiz Kids
content: (on what he wants) To make Apple a great $10 billion company. Apple has the opportunity to set a new example of how great an American corporation can be, sort of an intersection between science and aesthetics. Something happens to companies when they get to be a few million dollars â€“ their souls go away. And that's the biggest thing I'll be measured on: Were we able to grow a $10 billion company that didn't lose its soul?
